description: Public Snapchat profile from its web profile page: username, display name, page title and description, snapcode image and canonical link. Stories, Spotlight posts and follower counts are not shown on the public page and are not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: social_pinterest when you need latest pins of a public Pinterest profile from Pinterest's; social_tiktok when you need one public TikTok video by URL from the video page's. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
